scope: prepublication validation; final identities and after-publication preservation belong to final receipt
baseIdentityAuthority: GitHub Git object API plus branch readbacks; complete recursive tree not truncated
localValidation: Reconstructed exact base directory tree objects from authoritative recursive listing and seeded index; no full checkout of preexisting blobs. Local staged diff compared against exact base tree.

sensitiveContentScreen.scope: new publication files only; exact literal credential patterns, authenticated URLs, headers and internal connection details

newContentReview: fact-only selected fields; short data-use grant; no raw page bodies, descriptions, reviews, images, ratings, logos, private administrative records or credentials
productionBeforeAuthority: read-only deployment metadata and exact pickforus.app/www.pickforus.app alias mappings
